variants.title: Последовательные секции
variants.direction: LAYOUT 1: NATIVE VERTICAL EDITORIAL EPISODES. Normal page scroll, NO sticky demo, NO tabs, NO carousel. Each step is a complete full-width unit: small Step label, elegant 30px serif original step heading, then a large actual product detail image directly beneath, with 24px margins. Crop1 shows header, section introduction, Step1 heading and large upload sheet screenshot filling remaining height. Crop2 shows the middle scroll position, Step2 heading above large real language-menu screenshot and a hint of next episode below. Crop3 shows Step3 heading above large real translated reader screenshot. Layout calm, continuous, NOT three enclosing rounded cards. Generous but economical vertical rhythm. Each screenshot is integrated into page as a crisp printed inset; existing app UI remains as supplied. This is a reading-like scrolling story, clear without any interaction controls.
variants.prompt:
Create a polished UX art-direction presentation of a redesigned MOBILE "How it Works" section for Globoox. Output ONE landscape comparison board with exactly THREE equally sized mobile webpage crops side by side, each approximately 390x844 CSS px, at high resolution, on a subtly darker neutral surround with minimal gutters. No phone hardware, perspective, decoration, explanatory arrows, or invented marketing content. Each crop is a different state/scroll position of ONE coherent layout concept described below, not different concepts.
Reference image 1 is CURRENT PAGE STYLING and the BAD layout to replace: DO NOT reproduce its narrow side-by-side list and tiny screenshot. References 2,3,4 are AUTHENTIC Globoox product screenshots: use their recognizable real interface content as image crops faithfully. Do not invent or modernize their inner application UI. Upload sheet from ref2, translation language menu from ref3, translated Spanish reader from ref4. Product content must be large and clearly readable, width ~310-342 CSS px instead of tiny152px. Purposeful crops with enough context are encouraged. App visuals stay rectangular, lightly rounded, fine hairline edge; no large black device bezels.
Brand: contemporary literary restrained editorial design. Ivory #f7f5ed, forest ink #20382f, muted sage #718168, occasional tiny terracotta #b27650 accent, fine warm-gray rules. Newsreader serif headings with elegant natural weight and DM Sans interface labels; excellent optical spacing. NO antique parchment, yellowed paper, fake 3D, gradient blobs, cartoon illustrations, botanical ornaments or pill-card clutter. Use same compact sticky header with existing reference app icon, Globoox wordmark, hamburger, and inset hairline below it.
Exact section words: eyebrow "How it Works", heading "Three simple steps". Exact steps: "Step 1" and "Upload your ebook."; "Step 2" and "Choose your language to translate the book."; "Step 3" and "Enjoy your book!". Preserve these verbatim. No additional marketing prose. Numbers and simple functional navigation icons allowed. The long second heading must fit naturally without shrinking to microtype. Show actual mobile webpage interface, not a wireframe. Give the product the majority of each viewport and enough ivory breathing room. Keep all three panels on one board at identical scale.

variants.title: Большой экран с табами
variants.direction: LAYOUT 2: COMPACT TOP STEPPER. A stable single-viewport section, no pinned scroll runway. All three panels share header, eyebrow and compact heading at top, then a full-width horizontal THREE-PART NUMBERED STEPPER with 01 02 03 separated by hairline progress tracks, enough touch area. Under it a short active text area: small Step label and exact step title, followed immediately by ONE large product screenshot filling width and lower viewport. Active number in dark forest and short underline, others muted. Panel1 state1 upload, panel2 state2 language menu, panel3 state3 translated reading. Reserve same title-area height so screen does not jump on title change. Image width338px; align edges precisely. Controls are ABOVE content. Fit naturally in mobile height and keep image generously large. No card carousel, no side list.

variants.title: Аккордеон
variants.direction: LAYOUT 3: EDITORIAL ACCORDION. Mobile section title at top; below THREE full-width step rows stacked vertically with very fine inset dividing rules and slim plus/minus icon at right. Exact step headings live in each row, Step label tiny above. Expanded row reveals a large recognizable purposeful crop of its authentic screenshot directly underneath. Panel1 only Step1 expanded, Step2 and3 visible below. Panel2 Step1 collapsed, Step2 expanded, Step3 visible below. Panel3 first two rows collapsed and Step3 expanded. Keep all three step headings visible in each crop without cramped type: titles around23px, media around310px wide and300px tall using functional crop, not distorted whole screenshot. No enclosing rounded accordion boxes; flat editorial rows, generous clean spacing, thin lines only between steps. All available steps always obvious, tap selects one, no sticky scrolling.

variants.title: Свайп-карточки
variants.direction: LAYOUT 4: HORIZONTAL SWIPE GALLERY. Compact section heading at top, then an edge-to-edge horizontally scrollable track with a LARGE active rectangular editorial card approx326px wide on390px viewport and an obvious32px slice of the next card visible to the right (previous slice at laststate). Each card has small step label and exact title at TOP, and large authentic media crop BELOW, softly tinted ivory surface, fine edge, radius4px maximum. Cards should feel considered editorial panels not generic SaaS dashboard cards. Under track show restrained 01 / 03 count and two generous minimal arrow controls; no dots-only navigation. Panel1 firstcard upload, panel2 secondcard languagechoice, panel3 thirdcard reader. Neighbor fragments visibly differ. All active-card content together slides horizontally; browser page scroll remains native. Cards occupy most viewport, equal card heights, no sticky side rail or accordion.

variants.title: Экран сначала, описание снизу
variants.direction: LAYOUT 5: PRODUCT-FIRST EXHIBIT WITH BOTTOM CAPTION. Distinct from top tabs: small compact eyebrow and section heading, then immediately a very large full-width authentic product media viewport approximately342px wide and430px high. Beneath media a clean editorial caption shelf on PAGE background, not floating over the app: small Step label left, exact active serif step title underneath with ample line height. At bottom a horizontal three-segment understated progress navigator numbered1 2 3 with large touch areas and tiny next arrow at right. Panel1 upload, panel2 language choice, panel3 reading. Caption shelf has consistent fixed height for long second title. No card borders enclosing caption, no overlaid caption obscuring screenshot. Visual narrative starts with actual app action then explains it; controls anchored below. Subtle100ms-like crossfade implied by stable identical positioning, no motion blur. Calm exhibition-label composition, no top stepper, no scroll-pinned behavior.
